parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `AudioEnginePlayerTests.testPlay` (line 115) and `AudioEnginePlayerTests.testPlayIdempotent` (line 134) — carry `is_test: true` in their context flags. Although the two methods share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.909), they are distinct test cases in `AudioEnginePlayerTests.swift` within the `Playback` package: one verifies basic play behaviour and the other verifies idempotency of repeated play invocations. These are intentionally separate test scenarios whose near-identical shape reflects the nature of the system under test, not accidental duplication. Merging or extracting them would obscure test intent and couple unrelated assertions.
